capabilities: Show vault statistics (notes, links, tags, QoV) in a cycling status bar item
Analyze own vs source note ratios, orphans, trace, inbox health, and tag drift in a side view
Detect tangle notes that bridge large parts of the link graph and generate report notes
Track daily vault snapshots and render a 30-day history sparkline
Export the statistics history to CSV
extras: Desktop-only; requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer and will not run on mobile. Published in the official community plugin catalog. The README states the plugin makes no network requests and never modifies notes.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a modified fork of the Obsidian Vault Statistics Plugin.
problem: Obsidian shows no aggregate statistics about the vault itself, such as link density, orphan counts, or how notes are split between your own thinking and external material.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a modified fork of the Obsidian Vault Statistics Plugin.

summary: Statistics plugin that reports vault-wide counts, link density, own/source ratios, tangles, and 30-day trends in the status bar and a side view.
